findings.text: bats_execute now uses $BATS_SAVED_PATH, but the patch only changes this one line, so the variable is probably never set. In bats-core the backed-up path is stored in BATS_PATH, and this repo has no definition of BATS_SAVED_PATH to check. If it is unset, PATH becomes empty, and `bats_execute sed ...` or any other external command fails with 'command not found'. If the variable is set but holds a different value, internals run with the wrong PATH and mocks in the test's PATH can interfere with them again.
